title: Decimal Numbers to Hundredths: Models, Place Value and Fractions
seo_title: Grade 4 Decimals to Hundredths Worksheets with Answers (MATATAG Math 4)
standard_text: Represent decimal numbers using models and manipulatives to show the relationship to fractions; read and write decimal numbers with decimal parts to hundredths; determine the place value to hundredths of a digit in a given decimal number, the value of a digit, and the digit of a number, given its place value; convert decimal numbers to fractions, and fractions with denominators 10 or 100 to decimals.
meta_desc: Free Grade 4 decimals worksheets for the DepEd MATATAG curriculum: tenths and hundredths models, reading and writing decimals, place value, decimals and fractions, pesos and centavos. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Tenths come first after the point, then hundredths.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • A decimal is another way to write a fraction with a denominator of 10 or 100. 0.3 = 310 and 0.47 = 47100.
  • After the decimal point come the tenths, then the hundredths.
  • Read the whole number, say and for the point, then read the decimal part with the name of its last place: 3.45 is three and forty-five hundredths.
  • ₱1 = 100 centavos, so ₱0.25 is 25 centavos.

Examples

Example

7 hundredths

0 ones, 0 tenths, 7 hundredths

Answer: 0.07

Example

2.38

2 ones, 3 tenths, 8 hundredths

Answer: two and thirty-eight hundredths

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
7 hundredths as 0.70.7 is 7 tenths; 7 hundredths is 0.07.
Reading “point forty-five”Say “and”, then forty-five hundredths.
Mixing up the placesTenths come first after the point.

items.q: What decimal names the shaded part of the grid?
items.e: The grid has 100 equal squares, so each square is 1 hundredth and each full column is 1 tenth. 4 full columns and 7 squares are shaded: 4 tenths and 7 hundredths. That is 47100 = 0.47.

items.q: What decimal names the shaded part of the grid?
items.e: The grid has 100 equal squares, so each square is 1 hundredth. Only 8 squares are shaded and there is no full column, so there are 0 tenths. 8 hundredths = 8100 = 0.08.
